title: No automated negative test for the ODN-17 replay-gate drift rejection (#599-r2 mask risk)
evidence: ci.yml step 'Golden harness (T1 hashes + replay gate)' runs: odin run harness -- run  (happy path only). grep -rE 'drift|catalog_hash|logic_hz' core/*_test.odin shows no core unit test exercises catalog/logic_hz drift rejection.
detail: The gate works today (manual: logic_hz 20->21 -> FAIL; catalog drift -> 'defined rejection, ODN-11'), but a regression weakening the drift checks would pass CI — turning the gate into a mask on the spine's load-bearing invariant.
recommended_fix: Add a CI-exercised negative test: e.g. `harness replay <demo> <drifted-log>` or a core test asserting drift -> rejection.
